# University of Law

> The University of Law offers undergraduate and postgraduate law and business degrees with a focus on professional training and employability across 14 UK campuses and international locations.

University of Law provides comprehensive legal education from undergraduate through professional qualification pathways including the SQE solicitor training, apprenticeships, and continuing professional development. The institution operates multiple study modes (full-time, part-time, online) across UK campuses in Birmingham, London and other cities, plus international centers in Hong Kong, Berlin and Spain.

## Degree Programs

- [Find your course](https://www.law.ac.uk/study): Main course finder for law, business, psychology and other degrees
- [Undergraduate Law and Business Degrees](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/undergraduate): Undergraduate degree programs in law and business with employability focus
- [Postgraduate Law and Business Degrees](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/postgraduate): Postgraduate and master's programs in law and business with professional training
- [Bachelors and Masters Online Courses and Degrees](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/online): Online bachelor and master degrees with flexible distance learning options
- [Law and so much more](https://www.law.ac.uk/law-and-more): Overview of diverse course offerings beyond law including business programs

## Professional Qualifications & Training

- [The Solicitors Qualifying Examination (SQE) explained](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/sqe): Guide to SQE qualification and solicitor training pathway in England and Wales
- [Professional Legal Training](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/legal-training): Professional legal training and continuing development for practicing lawyers
- [Law Apprenticeships Programs](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/apprenticeships): Solicitor apprenticeships and graduate entry programs for career development
- [Higher Rights of Audience – Assessment](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/higher-rights-of-audience-assessment): Higher Rights of Audience assessment for advocacy qualification with CILEx

## Study Options & Modes

- [Different modes of study](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/study-modes): Study mode options including full-time, part-time and online across UK/Hong Kong
- [The locations of our campuses](https://www.law.ac.uk/locations): 14 UK campuses and international locations in Hong Kong, Berlin and Spain

## Fees, Funding & Financial Support

- [Undergraduate Course Fees and Funding](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/course-fees-and-funding): Undergraduate course fees, pricing and funding information for UK/international students
- [Postgraduate Course Fees and Funding](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/course-fees-and-funding): Postgraduate course fees and student finance options from Student Finance England/Wales
- [Scholarships and Bursaries](https://www.law.ac.uk/study/scholarships-bursaries): Scholarship and bursary programs for undergraduate and postgraduate students
